purpose: Define the active 2.5D/3D World Relational Atlas renderer while preserving the same canonical country, relationship, issue, programme, chronology and provenance model used by the rest of the repository.

navigation.pan: click/touch drag translates the camera across the map
navigation.zoom: wheel/pinch/buttons move between world, regional, country and subnational scales
navigation.rotate: right-drag / touch gesture rotates bearing in 3D mode
navigation.pitch: camera tilt exposes extrusion and vertical layers
navigation.fit: country selection fits actual polygon bounds; Trace and Compare can fit their current sets
navigation.globe: projection may switch between Mercator and globe view where supported
navigation.search: country-name and ISO3 search with suggestions
navigation.rule: Navigation changes viewpoint only; it never changes underlying data, chronology or epistemic classification.

interface.principle: Map first; persistent controls stay sparse while Layers, Trace, Time, View, inspector and Axis detail open only when useful.
interface.focus_mode: Temporarily hides informational overlays/HUDs without changing underlying map/data state.

renderer_architecture.shell: world-map/3d.html contains the public interface, progressive controls and map layout
renderer_architecture.application: world-map/3d-app.js owns MapLibre initialization, canonical country loading, Compare, recursive Trace, semantic modules, golden-angle navigation layout and URL state
renderer_architecture.hover_and_resilience: world-map/3d-hover.js owns resilient data boot, country hover and capital-city overlays
renderer_architecture.pathfinder: world-map/3d-pathfinder.js owns shortest-known-path navigation without creating a second map renderer
renderer_architecture.evidence: world-map/3d-evidence.js owns the Eye inspector for source provenance, observation dates, represented relation evidence and project-vs-empirical boundaries
renderer_architecture.time: world-map/3d-time.js owns Current / As-of / Compare-dates view state, URL persistence, conservative unknown-date handling and atlas-time-change events
renderer_architecture.interface_controller: world-map/3d-ui.js owns progressive disclosure, inspector/focus preferences, menu exclusivity, dynamic control relocation and compact Axis visibility
renderer_architecture.axis: world-map/3d-axis.js plus operator modules expose project-symbolic vertical navigation without turning it into physical geography
renderer_architecture.reason_for_split: Feature modules extend one renderer and shared public APIs rather than duplicating MapLibre state.

spatial_primitives.country_shell: Polygon/MultiPolygon selection surface and spatial context, not the country's complete identity.
spatial_primitives.country_hub: Representative navigation point when an exact entity coordinate is not relevant.
spatial_primitives.semantic_hub: Navigation-only handle for a country data module. Sibling hubs use stable golden-angle/phyllotactic placement; their screen/map positions are not claims about physical location or Fibonacci structure in the country.
spatial_primitives.trace_hub: Temporary representative marker for countries reached by recursive Trace; hop depth is graph distance only.
spatial_primitives.compare_hub: Temporary marker communicating active Compare selection state; leaving Compare clears these temporary states and URL membership.
spatial_primitives.real_node: Geocoded city, institution, facility, port, airport, base, sacred site, infrastructure asset or documented event with coordinate provenance.
spatial_primitives.nonspatial_node: Treaty, statistic, scripture, theology or other concept without one honest coordinate; expose through cards/trace/Axis scenes instead of fake pins.
spatial_primitives.edge: Typed relationship rendered between honest anchors when drawing it improves understanding.
spatial_primitives.area_overlay: Sourced region or area geometry with date and provenance.

country_interior_model.principle: A country polygon is a container. Selection unfolds canonical data into semantic modules and progressively exposes real spatial nodes as data quality and zoom permit.
country_interior_model.layout: Available semantic modules are placed by a Vogel-style golden-angle sequence to reduce spoke alignment and preserve relative placement as new modules are added. This is navigation geometry only.
country_interior_model.source_resolution: Modules resolve from canonical country records plus explicitly typed world/project context. Empty modules are not fabricated.

compare_mode.behavior: Keeps up to four country polygons selected while active, presents compatible descriptive comparisons, separates Inspect from Remove actions, and clears temporary compare state/hubs/URL membership on Done.
compare_mode.url_state: compare=ISO3,ISO3... persists the active comparison; exiting Compare removes it.
compare_mode.next: Add user-selected sourced metrics and relation-overlap/intersection views.

trace_mode.algorithm: bounded breadth-first traversal over data/world-relational-map.json curated country edges
trace_mode.cycle_handling: visited-country tracking prevents repeated cycles; each country is presented at its shortest discovered hop
trace_mode.filters: Relation type applies before traversal and persists in URL state.
trace_mode.epistemic_boundary: Hop count is graph-geodesic distance in the represented dataset, not causal, political, moral or evidentiary distance.
trace_mode.next: Generalize into entity-aware traversal using data/relationships.json and data/global-graph-bridge.json with time and epistemic filters.

path_mode.algorithm: BFS shortest known path across the active typed curated country graph
path_mode.data_resilience: Uses same-origin world-country-facts.json for country names first, with REST Countries as fallback.
path_mode.boundary: No path means not represented in the current dataset/filter, not no real-world relationship.

time_mode.current_overlay_guard: When historical mode is active, current-only project Fields and empirical Network overlays are suppressed and their selectors disabled unless a dated layer implementation can honestly replace them.
time_mode.north_history: An exact recovered project snapshot may be shown as context when the selected date exactly matches one; approximate/nearest snapshots are context only and are not projected forward as membership truth.
time_mode.boundary: Historical mode does not reconstruct old borders or silently treat present observations, memberships or project classifications as historically valid.

demography.population: 195-country sourced population snapshot with observation/reference years
demography.religion: Pew 2020 broad-category composition where available, kept separate from geopolitical interpretation
demography.boundary: Religious composition does not imply political loyalty or behavior.

evidence_mode.behavior: Eye exposes country fact provenance, population/religion observation dates and sources, represented relation layers/types and project-axis classifications for the selected country.
evidence_mode.boundary: Missing coverage is not falsehood; repetition is not corroboration; project interpretation is not empirical evidence.
evidence_mode.next: Add explicit filtering for epistemic class, confidence, source class, contradictions and freshness without collapsing unlike evidence into one truth score.

capital_and_country_facts.capital_nodes: Wikidata-backed capital city nodes with coordinates/name and population where returned; dated population statements are preferred by latest observation date and the date is exposed in hover.
capital_and_country_facts.facts_snapshot: world-country-facts.json is built same-origin from canonical country records with GeoNames fallback, exact area semantics and per-field provenance.

axis_mode.boundary: D-levels are project-symbolic/analytical navigation, not physical extra dimensions. The 42-degree North arc is a visual geometry parameter, not a level count, Fibonacci derivation or physical law.

mathematical_planes.geography: Real Earth coordinates and map projection.
mathematical_planes.topology: Represented graph connectivity; BFS/geodesic distance currently powers Trace and Path. Spectral layouts are reserved for a future explicitly non-geographic graph plane.
mathematical_planes.hierarchy: Axis D-levels are typed analytical/project navigation. A future Tree/Rooms view may experiment with hyperbolic hierarchy without distorting Earth geography.
mathematical_planes.time: As-of/reference time is orthogonal to geography, graph distance and hierarchy depth.
mathematical_planes.flow: Vortex/curl language remains analogy until directed quantitative edges share a quantity, unit and reference period; graph Hodge decomposition is the preferred future formalism once those gates are met.

resilience.geometry: same-origin deployed geometry snapshot is preferred, with provider fallbacks available through the resilient boot layer
resilience.country_metadata: same-origin generated country facts/demography snapshots are preferred; emergency synthesis/fallback remains available where defined
resilience.pathfinder: same-origin country facts are preferred before REST Countries
resilience.remaining_external_risk: MapLibre JS/CSS still loads from an external CDN and should eventually be vendored or otherwise made same-origin/version-pinned within licensing constraints.
resilience.failure_state: Required-data failure must produce a visible unavailable/error state rather than a silent empty map.

node_record_schema.boundary: Never invent a coordinate for a nonspatial concept merely to make the map visually busy.

metric_and_3d_rules.principle: Extrusion height is a chart encoding, not rank, holiness, guilt, value or sovereignty.

data_growth_strategy.current: Use country polygons, sourced facts/demography, stable semantic modules, a curated relationship graph, Path/Trace/Compare, conservative Time, an Eye evidence inspector and a project-symbolic Axis view.
data_growth_strategy.next_foundation: Make Time and Eye shared filters for normalized graph traversal and dated evidence, then expand Time only where source intervals are trustworthy.
data_growth_strategy.next_graph: Generalize country-only graph traversal into normalized country/institution/company/infrastructure/funding/ownership/programme relations.
data_growth_strategy.next_physical: Add high-value real spatial nodes: government institutions, ports, grids, cables, power plants, companies and research institutions.
data_growth_strategy.scale_rule: As the graph grows, lazy-load by view/zoom/country and move high-volume geometry to vector tiles/prebuilt packages rather than shipping the whole graph to every client.

next_priority: Extend Eye from inspection into filtering for epistemic class, confidence, source class, contradictions and freshness.
Expand recursive Trace into entity-aware traversal through data/global-graph-bridge.json and data/relationships.json, honoring Time/Evidence filters.
Upgrade selected empirical/project layers with valid_from/valid_to so historical Time mode can safely render them rather than suppressing current-only snapshots.
Prototype a separate deterministic spectral graph view before using graph-derived coordinates anywhere public.
Prototype a separate hyperbolic Tree/Rooms hierarchy without changing geographic coordinates.
Only after directed compatible quantitative flows are populated, evaluate graph Hodge decomposition for source/sink/cyclic structure.
Add real ports, grids, cables, power plants, institutions and company/funding/ownership chains for the North/European capability graph.
Normalize compatible GDP/debt/energy metrics with date/unit/source before new choropleths/extrusions.
Vendor or otherwise harden the remaining MapLibre CDN dependency.
Add programme/scenario simulation only after Time, Evidence and entity traversal are stable.
